200.description:
One catalogue record by database and priref (GET /web/Details/{database}/{priref}): every label/value row of the site's detail display with the value's text lines and links (field-search cross-references such as cast and credit prirefs, genre and subject term ids, linked items by object number, linked books and articles by priref; external links such as EIDR), the record's title, and the related records of its hierarchy display (film works list their film/video items with object number, format and status). Film works, persons/institutions, film items and books were verified; the other databases share the same page template.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | string |  |
| `fields` | object[] |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `priref` | string |  |
| `related_records` | object[] | Records linked by /web/Details/ URLs elsewhere on the page (the hierarchy display), the record itself excluded. |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `title` | string | First line of the record's Title (or Name) field; null when the display has neither. |

post.description:
Find BFI catalogue records (films, TV programmes, archive items, books, articles, posters, stills, people) matching field conditions, then follow the prirefs with `get_record`. Use `list_search_fields` first when unsure which field names a database supports.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

conditions.description: Field conditions combined in order with each condition's connective (the first connective is ignored by the site).

database.description:
Database (the form's SourceName): ChoiceFilmWorks = Film and Television Works, ChoiceFilmItems = film/video items, People = Persons and Institutions, ChoiceBooks, ChoiceSerials, ChoiceArticles, ChoicePresscuttings, ChoiceArchive (scripts, documents, ephemera), ChoicePosters, ChoiceStills, ChoiceSpecialCollections, ChoiceLibrary.

Provider reference: allowed values ["ChoiceFilmWorks", "ChoiceFilmItems", "ChoiceLibrary", "ChoiceBooks", "ChoiceSerials", "ChoiceArticles", "ChoicePresscuttings", "ChoiceSpecialCollections", "ChoiceArchive", "ChoicePosters", "ChoiceStills", "People"].

page.description:
1-based results page. Pass `next_page` from the previous output to continue.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 10000; default 1.

page_size.description:
Records per page; the site offers exactly these sizes.

Provider reference: allowed values ["10", "25", "50", "100", "250"]; default 25.

sort_direction.description:
sort_direction

Provider reference: allowed values ["Ascending", "Descending"]; default "Ascending".

sort_field.description: Sort field from `list_search_fields` sort_options (Search_SortTitle, Search_SortTitleDate, Search_SortName, ...). Default Search_Unsorted (the site's relevance/record order). Pattern: ^Search_[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,60}$.

lines: Name note: Born Stanley Augustus Holloway. Son actor Julian Holloway.
results.title: Holloway, Stanley

200.description:
Expert search of one BFI Collections Search database (POST /web/search/expert): one to five field conditions (field name from `list_search_fields`, value, right-truncation on by default, and/or/and-not connective), an optional sort field and direction, 10 to 250 records per page and a page number. Returns the result count, the page navigator and the brief rows of the requested page: priref, detail URL, title and the summary lines the site renders (credits, dates, country, work type, 'Part of:' series; activity type for persons) plus the collection badges (Film / Video material, Books, Articles, ...). Page 1 comes from the search POST; later pages re-run the search and read /web/results/{page} in the same session.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `collections` | string[] | Collection badges shown on the row (Published by BFI, Film / Video material, Digital Stills, Scripts / Documents / Ephemera, Articles, Books, Viewable at BFI Southbank Mediatheque, ...). |
| `detail_url` | string |  |
| `lines` | string[] | Every text line of the brief display in order, title included (credits, dates with their type, country, work type, category, 'Part of:' series; activity type or 'Use:' cross-reference for persons). |
| `links` | object[] | Links inside the row other than the record's own detail link (e.g. a person authority's 'Use:' target). |
| `position` | number | 1-based position in the whole result set. |
| `priref` | string | Record identifier; `get_record` takes it with the database. |
| `title` | string | First line of the brief display (title; name for persons). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
